name: AgentTimeIcon
source_reference: Project-owned Agent Time clock icon at src/ui/icon.svg; redesign keeps its clock silhouette.
brief: A clear, calm macOS icon for tracking developer and coding-agent time. Preserve the recognisable clock; use two hand colors for human and agent activity.

semantic_review.basis: The project-owned clock is a simple low-risk mark. An independent visual review accepted the recognizable ring and hand geometry at 64 px and in the macOS render.
semantic_review.notes: Intentional palette and geometry refresh, not pixel reproduction.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: Preserve a simple clock ring and two hands while improving contrast and small-size clarity.
must_preserve: hands meeting at the central pivot
simple silhouette visible at small sizes
acceptance_checks: no background duplication in Icon Composer assets
